metadata.description: Local marketplace for design-system plugins bundled with LtiRomGui.

plugins.name: kmp-liquid-glass
plugins.description: Build iOS-style liquid glass / frosted glass UI components in Compose Multiplatform using the io.github.kashif-mehmood-km:backdrop library. Provides recipes for cards, buttons, dialogs, tab bars, toggles, magnifiers, progressive blur, SDF shaders, and more — across Android, iOS, Desktop, and Web.
